name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_raw_keyboard_callback
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::RawKeyboardCallback dispatches raw key events through the numeric text input ftable when a context is present.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4b4b30 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4b4b30 validates fastcall key in ECX, callbackCtx in EDX, null context returning 0, and non-null context dispatch through derived ftable slot 0x84.
The native smoke verifies null context returns 0 and non-null context inserts accepted raw key characters through the numeric text input callback path.
